$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFPN (AIP France, AMDT 07/26, chart dated 2026-06-11).
Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed.
Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the simulator at run time; this file holds
what the simulator does not know: services, circuit rules and reporting points.
Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Paris Saclay Versailles (Toussus-le-Noble)

service.atsHours: 0600-2100 (UTC in winter, local time minus 1 h in summer)
service.outsideAtsHours: reserved for based VFR and IFR aircraft, air-air frequency; non-based aircraft prohibited without DSAC Nord authorisation

reportingPoints.name: S
reportingPoints.location: northern hill of the Chevreuse valley between Gif-sur-Yvette and Saint-Remy-les-Chevreuse (R171 TSU / 2.7 NM)
reportingPoints.purpose: compulsory arrival point; identify it by the two red and white high-voltage pylons, pass between them close to the south pylon

circuit.heightNote: departures climb in the circuit to 1500 ft AMSL before mid downwind; night circuit at 1500 ft AMSL
circuit.handNote: 07R: turn right after the farm 1000 m past the runways; 07L: external crosswind; 25: do not turn crosswind before the D36; prefer the inner base leg because of arrivals from S
circuit.restrictions: training patterns limited to 4 aircraft (3 outside ATC hours on weekends, 2 at night); class D light aircraft prohibited on weekends and holidays from April to September
circuit.silencePeriods: 1 April to 30 September, Sundays and holidays 1100-1400 (summer 1 h earlier): no thermal-powered traffic

arrivals.instruction: contact Chevreuse Info (or Toussus Tour if the SIV is inactive) 5 minutes before S; report at S at 1300 ft AMSL then join the outer base leg

arrivals.note: a direct approach for runway 07 is possible on ATC proposal or pilot request

departures.note: at the end of downwind follow 249 degrees
straight ahead, pass north of Magny-les-Hameaux and stay south of Voisins-le-Bretonneux

radio.arrival: once the runway is vacated, contact Toussus Sol directly for the taxi clearance

arrivals.note: if the runway in use is unknown, arrive at S at 1500 ft AMSL and fly overhead to examine the aerodrome

notes: VFR flight plan closure is mandatory outside ATC hours (BRIA).
Maximum speed in LF-R 35 A and in the circuit: the higher of 100 kt and 1.45 VS.
Avoid overflying the RBT DME because of concentrated traffic. Significant IFR traffic.
Give way to IFR aircraft in direct approach on 07L/25R.
